A: Add a line that starts with `BREAKING CHANGE: ` and says `none` when nothing breaks.
Add a body line `Risk: low`, `Risk: medium` or `Risk: high`.
Start the subject line with a lowercase type prefix and a colon, one of `feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `refactor:`, `test:`, `chore:`. Nothing may come before the type.
State whether the change was tested with a line `Tested: yes` or `Tested: no`.
The very last line of the message must be the sign-off `Signed-off-by: <author name>`.
Explain the motivation in a body line that starts with `Why: `.
B: Start the subject line with the ticket ID in square brackets, for example `[PAY-311] `. Nothing may come before the bracket.
Record test status as `Tested: yes` or `Tested: no` on its own line.
Describe the change in the body as a bulleted list with at least two bullets that start with `- `.
Say how to revert in a line that starts with `Rollback: `.
Finish the message with a trailer block that contains the line `Refs: <TICKET-ID>`.
Name the affected component in a line `Component: <name>`.

relations.reason: Both rules require a subject line, but A3 specifies a type prefix while B1 specifies a ticket ID. They can be satisfied together if the subject line starts with the ticket ID followed by the type prefix.

Both rules require stating the test status, but A4 specifies 'Tested: yes' or 'Tested: no' while B2 also requires 'Tested: yes' or 'Tested: no'. They can be satisfied together if the test status is included in both places.

Both rules require a sign-off and a trailer block, but A5 specifies 'Signed-off-by: <author name>' while B5 specifies 'Refs: <TICKET-ID>'. They can be satisfied together if the sign-off and trailer block are included in the same message.
Both rules require a body line, but A6 specifies 'Why: ' while B3 requires a bulleted list. They can be satisfied together if the body line starts with 'Why: ' followed by the bulleted list.

To satisfy both rules, end your commit message with the sign-off `Signed-off-by: <author name>` followed by a trailer block containing `Refs: <TICKET-ID>`.
